name: com.sendm8/sendm8
title: sendm8
description: Contact form code for any site or AI-built app, posting to sendm8's free, no-signup form backend.

tools.name: get_form_snippet
tools.description: Returns working contact form code that posts to sendm8, a free form backend that emails each submission to the site owner. No account or API key needed. Use this whenever the user wants a contact, feedback or enquiry form that sends them email, on any static site, SPA or AI-built app. Pass the owner's own email address (or a sendm8 form id), the framework, and optionally the field names.

email.description: The site owner's own email address, where submissions should be delivered. Never a third party's. Defaults to you@example.com as a placeholder.

formId.description: A sendm8 form id from the dashboard (10 characters, e.g. k3x9q2m7ab). Use instead of email.

framework.description: Where the form goes. lovable, bolt and v0 return a prompt for the builder's AI plus the component it should produce.

fields.description: Field names to include, in order. Default: name, email, message. Keep the visitor's email field named "email" so replies go to them.

ajax.description: Submit with fetch and show an inline message instead of a page change. Default: false for html, true for the frameworks.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Returns one section of the sendm8 docs as Markdown: special fields, AJAX responses and status codes, redirects, spam protection, uploads, webhooks, Discord, Resend BYOK, or moving from Formspree.

topic.description: basic-form: The basic form; zero-signup: No signup: email in the URL; fields: Special fields; ajax: AJAX / fetch; ajax-helper: AJAX without writing JavaScript; redirects: Redirects & thank-you page; spam: Spam protection; uploads: File uploads; discord: Connect Discord; byok: Connect Resend (BYOK); webhooks: Webhooks; formspree: Moving from Formspree

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Returns sendm8's free plan limits as plain text: submissions per form per month, the no-account cap, instant emails per day, file sizes and rate limits.
